_about: Every word the page shows or speaks. Edit here, then run: python3 presentation/demo/tools/build.py. The voice clips (tools/make_voice.py) read the same file, so text and sound never drift apart. A native speaker has not checked the Swahili yet.

sw.name: Kagua Jani
sw.ask: Je, jani hili la kahawa lina kutu?
sw.introVoice: Piga picha ya jani. Utaona jibu na kulisikia. Huwezi kuharibu chochote.
sw.note: Ni msaada tu. Mtu ndiye anayeamua.

next.rust: Hili ni jani moja. Kabla ya kutumia pesa, onyesha jani hili kwa afisa ugani au ushirika wako.
next.no_rust: Hili ni jani moja tu. Kagua majani mengine. Ukiwa na wasiwasi, onyesha mtu.
next.not_sure: Hii haimaanishi kuwa jani lina afya. Onyesha jani hili kwa afisa ugani au ushirika wako.

sw.sheetLine: Jibu la kompyuta. Si uchunguzi. Tafadhali kagua jani hili.
sw.sheetAsk: Maswali ya kuuliza: 1. Je, hii ni kutu ya kahawa? 2. Nifanye nini sasa?
sw.saved: Picha ya mfano {n} kati ya 4. Jibu lililohifadhiwa.
helperSteps: Fungua ukurasa huu mara moja ukiwa na intaneti.
Ongeza kwenye skrini ya mwanzo (kwenye menyu ya kivinjari).
sw.limits: Zana hii ni mpya. Imejifunza kwa picha za majani kutoka Brazil. Tuliijaribu kwa picha 300 kutoka Uganda. Inaweza kukosea. Isipojua, inasema “Sina uhakika”.
sw.basicIntro: Huu ni mfano tu. Hizi ni picha nne za mfano, na jibu la kompyuta kwa kila moja.
alt: Jani la kijani lenye madoa makubwa ya rangi ya machungwa
Jani la kijani laini, lisilo na madoa
Jani la manjano iliyofifia, mwanga mwingi
Picha isiyo wazi yenye kijani na kahawia
sw.homeSim: Huu ni mfano tu. Kamera haipigi picha halisi. Majibu yamehifadhiwa kutoka kwa modeli halisi.
sw.camHint: Weka jani moja kwenye fremu, kisha bonyeza kitufe.
sw.simNote: Kamera haipigi picha halisi. Picha ni ya mfano, na jibu limehifadhiwa kutoka kwa modeli halisi.
sw.analyzingNote: Kwenye programu halisi, hatua hii hufanyika ndani ya simu, bila intaneti.

en.name: Leaf check
en.ask: Does this coffee leaf have rust?
en.note: Only a help. A person decides.

next.rust: This is one leaf. Before you spend money, show this leaf to the extension officer or your cooperative.
next.no_rust: This is only one leaf. Check other leaves. If you are worried, show a person.
next.not_sure: This does not mean the leaf is healthy. Show this leaf to the extension officer or your cooperative.

en.sheetTitle: For the extension officer or cooperative
en.sheetLine: A computer answer. Not a diagnosis. Please inspect this leaf.
en.sheetAsk: Questions to ask: 1. Is this coffee leaf rust? 2. What should I do now?
en.audioFail: The sound is not available right now.
helperSteps: Open this page once while you have internet.
Wait until you see “Works without internet”.
Add it to the home screen (in the browser menu).
en.limits: This tool is new. It learned from leaf photos from Brazil. We tested it on 300 photos from Uganda. It can be wrong. When it cannot tell, it says “Not sure”.
alt: Green leaf with large orange patches
Smooth green leaf with no spots
Pale yellow leaf, washed out by bright light
Blurry photo in green and brown
en.cameraBtn: Take a photo of the leaf
en.homeSim: This is only an example. The camera does not take a real photo. The answers are saved from the real model.
en.camHint: Put one leaf in the frame, then press the button.
en.simNote: The camera does not take a real photo. The photo is a sample, and the answer is saved from the real model.
en.analyzingNote: In the real app, this step runs inside the phone, with no internet.
